text-5.value: Web design careers offer growing demand, competitive salaries, and creative opportunities. Designers focus on site appearance, usability, and functionality, while developers handle technical aspects like performance and coding.

text-9.label: As the internet continues to expand at an unprecedented pace, careers related to web design and deve
text-9.value: As the internet continues to expand at an unprecedented pace, careers related to web design and development are growing alongside it. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics predicts that by 2029, job opportunities in these fields will grow by 8%—faster than the average for all occupations. Whether you aim for a salaried position or a freelance career, web design offers diverse employment arrangements, competitive compensation, and the chance to merge technical expertise with creative vision.

text-22.value: Web Developers: Build and maintain websites, focusing on technical aspects such as site performance, back-end functionality, and capacity. They may specialize in front-end, back-end, or full-stack development, using programming languages, frameworks, and libraries.

text-27.value: The demand for web designers and developers continues to grow as digital presence becomes crucial for businesses, organizations, and individuals. With 17.4 billion websites in existence as of January 2020, the need for skilled professionals shows no signs of slowing.

education-1-description.value: Building a strong foundation in programming, networking, software development, and computer systems, with a particular focus on cybersecurity and offensive security.

experience-1-description.label: experience-1-description
experience-1-description.value: Designed and developed an automated, cloud-based web vulnerability scanner using Python and FastAPI. Built custom security testing modules for web applications and REST APIs, integrated offensive security tools, and implemented AI-assisted vulnerability reporting with actionable remediation guidance.

experience-2-description.label: experience-2-description
experience-2-description.value: Administered and secured Linux production servers, implemented system hardening techniques, and maintained reliable infrastructure operations. Developed Python and PowerShell automation tools for system diagnostics, troubleshooting, and security monitoring, strengthening my foundation in infrastructure security and system administration.

about-intro.label: about-intro
about-intro.value: I'm a Junior Web Security Specialist based in Zurich, Switzerland, focused on web application security, vulnerability analysis, and practical penetration testing.

about-focus.label: about-focus
about-focus.value: I build tools that make security testing more useful. My project, NetNeedle, brings together web and REST API assessments, automated scanning, and AI-assisted remediation reporting using Python and FastAPI.

about-background.label: about-background
about-background.value: I'm an HTB Certified Web Exploitation Specialist (CWES). My background also includes Linux infrastructure hardening, security monitoring, and automation with Python and PowerShell.

journey-1.label: journey-1
journey-1.value: My path combines computer science studies at IISAT with hands-on systems work. Programming, networking, and software development have helped me understand how applications and infrastructure fit together, and where security weaknesses can appear.

journey-2.label: journey-2
journey-2.value: Working on infrastructure at 11ven Tech Yards gave me practical experience with Linux servers, troubleshooting, and system hardening. Writing Python and PowerShell tools helped me turn repeated diagnostic tasks into reliable automation.

journey-3.label: journey-3
journey-3.value: That experience carried into NetNeedle. I built a cloud-based vulnerability scanner with Python and FastAPI, bringing together web application checks, REST API testing, and reporting. The goal is to turn findings into remediation guidance that developers can use.

journey-4.label: journey-4
journey-4.value: Today, I keep developing my web security skills through practical testing, Hack The Box, and CTF challenges. I'm interested in work that connects careful vulnerability analysis with building better security tools.
